title: Design System: Saturn — Steam Game Add

display.purpose: Main game-add wordmark; 32px in short desktop windows, 31px or 28px on mobile.

label.purpose: Supporting copy, filter text and catalogue metadata; mobile narrows to 11–12px.

shadows.name: action-rest
shadows.purpose: Subtle white light under the primary button.

shadows.name: cover-selected
shadows.purpose: Selected cover ring, in addition to its bright border.

shadows.name: wallpaper-text
shadows.purpose: Protects game titles, metadata and workspace labels over the live starfield.

shadows.name: queue-popover
shadows.purpose: Centered non-modal queue separation above the still-visible Saturn scene.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.value: background .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, color .18s ease

motion.name: cover-image
motion.purpose: Full-color cover artwork retains filter:none at rest and when selected; hover scales to 1.025.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Reduced-motion transition/animation override; cover hover transform is removed, and video initially pauses.

motion.name: queue-arrive
motion.purpose: Popover arrives from translateY(8px) scale(.985) and zero opacity; reduced motion nearly removes the transition.

narrative.overview:
The implemented world follows the user's black Saturn reference and supplied monochrome video: a live starfield fills the entire window behind the gallery and all views. Transparent black panels, fine neutral outlines, spaced display lettering and quiet white light preserve that atmosphere. Cover imagery supplies the gallery's color, following the added PlayStation Store reference.

This system belongs to the Turkish Steam catalogue interface and its Windows Electron shell. Source labels distinguish live store results from the 1,000-game bundled catalogue. Queue completion, library entries and history retain explicit local-preview scope. Source evidence: current `outputs/steam-game-add/style.css`, `index.html`, `app.js` and `electron/main.cjs`, checked against `PRODUCT.md` and `work/surface-brief.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Full-window black space with transparent black surfaces and fine borders.
Light geometric display type paired with readable Manrope utility text.
A white primary action and cover-led game selection.
Paginated Steam results, restrained status signals and explicit local-preview copy.

rules.name: The Quiet Light Rule
rules.body: Keep interface emphasis white; reserve green and rose for state. Preserve cover artwork's own colors.

dos: **Do** preserve the supplied monochrome Saturn world and full-window live starfield behind all views.
**Do** use the white primary action, compact utility text and visible selection outline.
**Do** keep keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior visible and functional.
**Do** retain local-preview scope in queue, library and history copy.
**Do** distinguish live Steam result counts from the bundled catalogue.
donts: **Don't** spread status green across decorative surfaces.
**Don't** cover the gallery or workspace with an opaque gray curtain.
**Don't** replace bundled cover art with generic illustrations when the catalog has an actual cover.
**Don't** describe preview completion as a change to the user's Steam library.
